what_this_is: A publication defect found while adding a figure: the hydrated model card referenced six image assets that had NEVER been uploaded to its Hub repo, so the multi-GPU serving section rendered broken images on huggingface.co while every automated check we had reported success.

defect.symptom: 6 of 12 assets referenced by MODEL_CARD-K5K6-hydrated.md were absent from the model repo
defect.root_cause: publish_cards.py uploads README.md and the DOCS-SHA256SUMS row and NOTHING ELSE. Card byte-identity and asset presence are independent invariants, and only the first was ever checked. A card can therefore pass publish_cards with all_byte_identical true and still ship broken images.
defect.why_it_went_unnoticed: The topology and scaling figures were committed to git in the same commit that created them, so they looked published. git and the Hub are separate stores; nothing reconciled them.
defect.blast_radius: Hydrated card only. The audit run across all eight repos found context (6/6), K5K6 (10/10) and K4 (8/8) complete, and the four remaining cards reference no assets.

fix.immediate: uploaded 12 files (the 6 referenced svgs plus their 6 sibling pngs) via the authenticated hf CLI
fix.durable: new tool tools/sync_card_assets.py - audits every repo in publish_cards.CARDS for assets its card references, exits non-zero when any are missing, and uploads them with --upload. It imports publish_cards directly so CARDS and HF_HOME cannot drift between the two tools.
fix.gotcha_encoded: the tool sets HF_HOME to publish_cards.HF_HOME before constructing HfApi. Without it the default cache is unauthenticated, uploads 401, and the read-only audit still appears to work - the worst possible failure mode, and one I hit while writing this.

verification.audit_after_fix: all 8 repos report OK or 'no asset references'; exit code 0

standing_rule: Run tools/sync_card_assets.py after any commit that adds or renames a card figure. publish_cards' all_byte_identical is necessary but NOT sufficient for a correctly published card.
